schema_note: Fixture allowlist for the synthtwin data-provenance guard (plan D13). Each entry in 'fixtures' binds one committed data fixture to its origin and must contain exactly these keys: 'path' (repository-relative POSIX path of the committed fixture file), 'generator' (repository-relative path of the seeded script that rebuilds the fixture; invoked as: python <generator> --seed <seed> --out <output-path>), 'seed' (integer seed; the same seed must always produce the same bytes on every platform), 'sha256' (64-character lowercase hex digest of the committed fixture bytes), and 'justification' (a written sentence explaining why this fixture must be committed instead of being built at test time). The checker tools/provenance/check_provenance.py re-runs every generator and byte-compares its output to the committed file; any difference fails. Committed fixtures must be tiny (at most 100000 bytes). Phase 0 commits no fixtures, so the list is empty.
